newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Crown says 1st qtr up on year ago.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Crown says 1st qtr up on year ago.

text.p: Casino operator Crown Ltd said on Wednesday that its first quarter of the 1996/97 financial year was stronger than last year.

"The first quarter (July-September) is somewhat stronger than the first quarter of last year," Crown chairman Lloyd Williams told the annual meeting, adding that the second quarter is normally stronger again.
"The first quarter performance of the overall business compared with the first quarter of the previous year is up ... which is a good sign and I'm delighted to report that," Williams said.
"I think that as we look forward into the second quarter, the second quarter normally is stronger again if you go on history," he said.
Williams declined to comment further to reporters after the meeting on the first quarter performance.
Crown, 37 percent owned by investment firm Hudson Conway Ltd, reported a net profit of A$58.38 million in the year to June 30, 1996 from A$33.17 million in 1994/95.
Crown shares were three cents lower at A$2.85 at 10.50 a.m. (0050 GMT) on Wednesday.
